description: 8004-gated agent vault and job escrow on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32.1). The lab registered an 8004 agent with ATOM enabled, initialised and funded a vault, set a policy, spent 3_000_000 tokens as owner past a 2_000_000 per-tx cap, and withdrew the remaining 2_000_000. A 1_000_000 escrow job was accepted: the vault ATA received 990_000 after a 100 bps fee and the escrow ATA closed.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of Atlantid-Fondation/atlantid-programs. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/atlantid-programs. The lab changed declare_id for agent_vault and agent_escrow to unique Sol.College devnet programs. Vault creation is gated on the official devnet 8004 registry (8oo4J9tB…) plus a Metaplex Core agent asset with ATOM enabled; the lab did not redeploy 8004. The hosted IDL is the lab build of agent_vault (agent_escrow.json is also hosted). The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize_root_config, create_vault, spend, withdraw, and the escrow job lifecycle)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/atlantid-programs/
QA: devnet proof of the 8004 vault ceremony and escrow create/mark_completed/accept_work payout
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)
Agent-wallet spend path (set_agent_wallet) and dispute/timeout cranks

assignments.title: Exercise set_agent_wallet plus cap-enforced spend as the 8004 agent wallet on the hosted console
